You will work closely with colleagues across geographies, functions, and cultures, contributing to the daily execution and continuous improvement of Hempel’s Compliance Program.
   

  

 Hempel’s Corporate Head Office is located in Lyngby, Denmark. The Compliance \& Data Protection team supports the entire Hempel Group globally, and this role is based in Pune, India, serving as an essential operational hub.
   

  

**Your Role And Key Responsibilities**
 As Compliance Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for the reliable and high‑quality execution of core compliance processes, helping ensure that Hempel’s standards are consistently applied across the organisation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Assisting with roll out of Compliance training courses, primarily online learning programs
* Supporting compliance assessments of business partners (e.g. distributors and third parties)
* Handling and reviewing sanctions screening alerts in line with internal procedures
* Providing general operational and administrative support to the Compliance \& Data Protection team
* Maintaining and updating cases in the Whistleblowing system
* Taking minutes during investigation meetings and ensuring secure and confidential record management
* Handling sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of professionalism and integrity


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* Compliance processes are delivered accurately, on time, and consistently
* Stakeholders trust you as a reliable and professional compliance partner
* Data, reports, and systems are well\-maintained and audit‑ready
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
* You take ownership while working effectively as part of a global team

**You Are**
* Diligent, precise, detail‑oriented, and dependable
* Highly trustworthy with a strong sense of confidentiality
* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities across compliance areas
* Comfortable working with data, documentation, and reporting
* A strong written and spoken English communicator
* A confident user of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
